text:
maya: Quick heads-up — need to schedule a 45m design review for the new "structured outputs" work (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: agree API contract, SDK ergonomics, and console inspector view + rollout plan.

jon: I'm +1. Prefer Tues morning PT. Can make Tue 09:00 PT or Wed 16:00 PT work.

srini: Tue 9 PT works for me. Who are we asking to review the API surface? @elisabeth?

elisabeth: Yep I can review the API and console mockups. Want the prototype link and perf numbers in advance.

maya: Checklist for prework — please drop these in the doc at least 24h before the meeting:
- API diff (openapi/raml or curl examples)
- SDK usage examples (TS + py)
- Console mockups (Figma link) + brief flows
- Perf rough numbers (p50/p95 tokens/sec and memory) or emulator runs
- Migration notes for existing clients
- Security notes: auth scopes and data leakage concerns
- Rollout plan + fallback strategy

ash: Adding infra impact: any change to model serving routing? if so add expected latency delta and autoscale hints.

maya: small example API snippet for pre-reads:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model":"redwood-structured-1",
  "input":"Summarize this ticket",
  "structure": {"type":"json_schema","schema_id":"summary_v1"}
}
```

jon: I'll add a short SDK snippet and a simple unit test showing structured output parsing.

srini: Voting: :one: Tue 09:00 PT, :two: Wed 16:00 PT. Reply with :one: or :two: in thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please include any migration flags or feature toggles you plan to use.

elisabeth: Also add two acceptance criteria items: console should show raw+parsed view, and API should return parsable error codes for schema mismatches.

maya: Cool — if we get 3+ :one: votes we'll lock Tue 09:00 PT. I'll ping infra for a Zoom + recording. If you can't make it, please leave async comments on the doc — we'll time-box discussion to 45m.

ash: Noted. I'll attach autoscale hints and a small perf run.

jon: done — SDK pre-read link: https://go/redwood/dev/structured-sdk-preread (will update before EOD)

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will confirm by EOD and post final invite + doc link. :thumbsup:
